caveat: that run overlapped with unrelated diagnostics on the same laptop, so its timings are an upper bound; a warm rerun of the same stages is in results/parts/timings.json
method: git clone into a clean directory outside the working tree, checkout of the tag commit; uv sync --frozen with a fresh empty UV_CACHE_DIR and a new .venv; `demo` run from the COMMITTED artifacts; then the README quick-start commands in order with PYTHONHASHSEED=0 (make is not installed on the verification machine; the Makefile reproduce target runs the same ten stages in the same order). Implemented by scripts/verify_fresh_clone.sh.
where_the_verified_sha_is: a commit cannot contain its own SHA, so the exact SHA verified at the FINAL tagged commit, its timings and the metrics.json comparison are recorded in the annotated tag message (`git show v1.0-konnect-submission`); `bash scripts/verify_fresh_clone.sh` repeats the check for any ref.
